verifiedScope: One private August 2026 PDC Pdf Generator PDF; structural and clock arithmetic evidence only; no public P1 sample

mustValidate: PDF syntax and readable text layer
printed report kind AND exact ordered headers
single primary body grid with validated column ownership
Period range and date anchors independently
raw clock syntax and explicit day-offset tokens
source fingerprint and physical field locator

Date.state: own cell only; missing is unresolved
Date.yearAuthority: requires independently validated profile-specific century and period

Pairing.state: raw only; no duty identity or forward fill

Activity.state: 3/4-digit candidate only; preserve raw code; never sufficient to create FlightRecord

AircraftOrHotel.state: raw mixed semantic; never assume registration

PrintedBlockHours.state: raw Blk Hrs, minute-parseable; not canonical Block or Skia BLH

extraction.unit: one printed body baseline, not one crew/duty/flight
extraction.geometry: observed coordinates are sample fingerprint, not portable tolerances
extraction.columnMapping: validated grid regions; right-aligned Blk Hrs body text x=511 despite header x=492
extraction.publication: UNKNOWN; print timestamp and PDF CreationDate are output-generation metadata only

classificationOrder: validate numeric candidate's From/To and four clocks and printed Block
validate explicit date or stage as unresolved
only then compare to existing owner Flight after explicit review
validation.baseElapsedCheck: (STA_B with explicit +day) - (STD_B with explicit +day) == printed Blk Hrs; sample 26/26; validation only
validation.localElapsedCheck: do not reject merely because station-local elapsed differs from printed Blk Hrs; sample 16/26 equal
validation.dateRollover: preserve +1 per clock cell; never infer missing Date or canonical operational date
validation.unsupported: fail closed with review reason and no FlightRecord or crew creation

reconciliation.matching: verified UID-owned active Flight; unique full date+approved carrier-specific flight+route; compare source and company independently
reconciliation.approval: bind exact verified source-stage digest, UID, Flight ID, expected FlightRevision, expected EvidenceHead, source locator and receipt
reconciliation.write: separate atomic evidence-only store/receipt; no canonical Flight revision, Block, aggregate, outbox or data-generation change
reconciliation.revisions: append snapshots; no silent overwrite; changed crew or same value with new fingerprint remains distinct observation
reconciliation.backupRestore: quarantine imported stages/approvals/receipts; never trust backup checksum as authority

evidence.actual: Independent binary-safe decode of one private PDC PDF and 495 text objects; exact header, 49 bands, 26/22/1 classification and 26/26 base clock arithmetic
evidence.synthetic: Research contract negative fixtures only; not Flutter or Sembast
evidence.blocked: 2018/2019/2020-2026 historical PDFs return empty base64 payload at GitHub connector size limit; no original-byte interpretation
notExecuted: company XLSX value-level rejoin in this cycle
real Skia same-export year and crew antecedent certification
Dart/Sembast evidence-only API and transaction acceptance

acceptanceScenarios.input: wrong printed report kind or shifted header
nonnumeric Activity with From/To and four clocks
numeric Activity with omitted Date after numeric or nonflight band
explicit +1 on departure or arrival cell
zero or multiple verified active UID Flight matches
same receipt ID with changed fingerprint/locator/crew
backup-origin approval without trusted source-stage revalidation
